results.title: Christmas Escape Room for Kids, Printable Toy Workshop Puzzle Game, Ages 8-10
results.description:
The Christmas workshop door has locked itself just before the toys are ready. Solve nine different puzzles, collect a digit from each, and open the nine-dial door. This is a complete print-and-play Christmas escape room for children ages 8-10, with an adult host guide and a low-ink printing option.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
• Color Player Game — 16 US Letter PDF pages.
• Low-Ink Player Game — the SAME 16 game pages in a lighter print style.
• Adult Host Guide — 6 PDF pages with setup, nine explained answers, two hints per puzzle, and a read-aloud ending.

There are 22 unique pages across the game and guide. The two player PDFs are print styles of one game, not separate adventures. The game includes a story briefing, puzzle pages, code sheet, ending, and optional certificate/name badges.

HOW TO PLAY
Choose one player file and print it single-sided. Work through the nine puzzles, write each answer on the code sheet, then check the completed door code. An adult can host with the separate guide, read the ending aloud, and offer hints when needed. The game can be played solo or cooperatively. Allow roughly 45-60 minutes, depending on age and group; this is an estimate, not a guaranteed play time.

PUZZLE MIX
Observation, patterns, a mirror clue, route tracing, simple arithmetic, a letter cipher, and a maze. The nine answers form one final code. No separate lock, cut-out props, or envelopes are needed.

PRINTING & MATERIALS
You need a printer, paper, pencils, and a PDF reader. On US Letter paper, select Actual Size / 100%. On A4 paper, select Fit to Page. The host guide can stay on screen. The game uses English text. No color vision is required to solve the puzzles: relevant ribbon colors are also written as words.

DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
This is an instant-download digital product. No physical item is shipped. Files are not editable. Download your purchase from Etsy in a web browser.

USE
Print for your household or your own classroom. Do not share, upload, redistribute, or resell the PDFs. Commercial event-hosting rights are not included.

CREATION PROCESS
This original game was designed and laid out with AI assistance, including the cover illustration. The puzzle sequence and answer path were reviewed for consistency. No third-party characters or artwork were used.

results.title: Christmas Scavenger Hunt Printable: Gift Reveal Present Hunt Clue Cards for Kids, Teens, Adults
results.description:
Christmas scavenger hunt printable for ages 3 to adult, instant download: 60 clue cards in three levels turn one present into a hunt around your home.

Where's your present hiding? You hide the clue cards, hand over the start card, and your child follows the trail from card to card to a present on Christmas morning. One download has a level for every age in the family, so a 4-year-old and a 12-year-old can hunt the same morning.

Three levels
Pictures, ages 3 to 5: 12 cards with three drawn pictures and one line you read aloud.
Rhymes, ages 6 to 9: 24 rhyming riddles.
Tricky, ages 10 to adult: 24 riddles with a twist.
Pick a level for each child.

How it works
1. Plan: choose 5 to 12 spots with the Hunt Planner (page 3 of Start Here).
2. Print: at 100% (actual size), single-sided, then cut on the dashed lines.
3. Hide: put each card where the card before it points. The present goes where the last one points.
Then hand over the start card and Clue 1. Each clue found means one ornament colored on the tracker.

Time: 20 to 40 minutes to plan, print and hide the first time, and a hunt takes 15 to 30 minutes to play (both from the Start Here page).

What's in the download
One ZIP with a Letter folder and an A4 folder, 7 PDFs and 28 pages in each, plus a READ-ME:
01 Start Here, 5 pages (how it works, the Hunt Planner, a card key for grown-ups, and a thank-you page)
02 Clue Cards 1: Pictures, ages 3-5, 3 pages (12 picture cards)
03 Clue Cards 2: Rhymes, ages 6-9, 6 pages (24 rhyme cards)
04 Clue Cards 3: Tricky, ages 10 to adult, 6 pages (24 tricky cards)
05 Start and finale cards, 3 pages (12 cards, including "Too big to hide!" for a present you can't hide)
06 Write-your-own cards, 2 pages (8 cards, for any spot we missed)
07 Ornament trackers, 3 pages (for 5, 6, 7, 8, 10 or 12 clues)

Print and names
Cards print 4 to a page. Color or black and white both work. Type names into the cards on screen before printing, or write them by hand.

For grown-ups
Start Here page 4 shows where each card leads, so keep that page away from the hunters. Start Here also lists safe places to hide cards.

You need a printer, scissors, a pen or crayons, and the present.

Crumble the Elf Hid the Party is our Christmas escape game for ages 8 to 11, if your children want a second challenge at a party.

Before you buy
This is a digital download and nothing is shipped. The present is not included. After payment, download the ZIP from Etsy.com in a web browser; the Etsy app can't download digital files, and guest buyers can use the link in their receipt email. If a file gives you trouble, message the shop with the file name and page number.
For use in your own home. Please do not resell or share the files.
Written and designed by SeasonalMood using AI writing and design tools.
